payload.title: Close silent bypasses and record overrides honestly
payload.description: Gitleaks still honours inline gitleaks:allow and a root .gitleaksignore, with no reason recorded. Disable or detect both. In receipt mode, record 'override' instead of 'clean' when the allowlist was used. Consider repo-level allow patterns with reasons, and a baseline mode that reports findings already in history. (Biblicus #7 and #9)
